text: Yes, native forest was deforested on this property in 2022. Earth-observation data shows a 0.6-hectare loss of tree cover within the 17.6-hectare asset, which was corroborated by multiple sources. The area affected was confirmed as native forest (0.5 hectares) by Uruguay’s national forest map (MGAP 2021). The change was detected as stand-replacing loss, meaning the trees were cleared or removed. However, the data does not specify whether the deforestation was legal, authorized, or caused by a particular actor.
